verdict.rationale: Missive's own docs say it manages email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more in one shared inbox. The pricing page lists "Email, SMS, social accounts," and the API reference documents handling of WhatsApp messages. Because the story asks for SMS, WhatsApp, social, *or* live chat beside email, this covers it directly. missing for 10: any evidence of a live-chat channel, in-depth per-channel setup documentation for SMS/WhatsApp/social, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these channels working in the shared inbox.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email

citations.quote: Manage email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more in one shared inbox.
For WhatsApp messages, the id in from_field and to_fields identifies authors and recipients by their Business-Scoped User ID (BSUID)
